integrity_statement: Tables obtained from explicit finite exhaustive programs with exact integer checks, not extrapolation. Self-review is not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite census only for binary lengths 1–28. The direct independent enumerator covers 1–25. No asymptotic variance theorem; incomplete access to the 2004 primary full text leaves residual bibliographic risk.
title: Exact binary unbordered-conjugate frequency census through length \(28\)
